author_note1: (Why Lili didn't betray and run off in Canon)
p229: In canon, Lili stole Bell's knife and ran off. In this story, she didn't. The reason why is because of a couple of reasons. The first reason is that Lili knew she had no chance in trying to steal the knife regardless. Sora is constantly around, meaning she can't easily steal it while Sora is unknowingly keeping an eye on her. Even if she were to just blatantly steal it and run off, Lili knows that Sora can easily catch up to her.
p230: The second (and most important) reason is that Lili has been developing a closer bond more than she ever did compared to canon, which acts as a stronger conscience to her usual activities. She saw how genuine Bell and Sora are towards her. One key moment is Bell protecting her from a devastating blow with his own body, which left a deep impression on her. And said impression has made her very hesitant on trying to steal from Bell, or do anything remotely bad in general.
p231: So yeah, it's because of these reasons that Lili stuck with them the whole way, rather than going through with her usual actions.
